questions.text: What Filipino dish is meat stewed in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaves?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: chicken adobo, pork adobo, adobong manok, adobong baboy.

questions.text: What Filipino shaved-ice dessert gets its name from words meaning "mix-mix"?
Which Filipino fast-food chain is famous for its Chickenjoy and Yumburger?
What fertilized duck egg is sold by street vendors at night?
What sour Filipino soup is often flavored with tamarind?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept any kind: sinigang na baboy, sinigang na hipon, etc.

questions.text: What noodle dish is served at Filipino birthdays because it symbolizes long life?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pansit, pancit canton, pancit bihon, pancit palabok.

questions.text: Filipino-style party spaghetti is famous for its sweet sauce and slices of what?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: hot dogs, sausage.

questions.text: What Filipino stew of oxtail and vegetables is cooked in a thick peanut sauce?
What purple yam is used to make halaya and many Filipino desserts?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: ubi. Not taro (gabi) or kamote.

questions.text: What "silog" breakfast combines cured beef, garlic fried rice and a fried egg?
questions.hostNotes: Tapa + sinangag + itlog. Not tocilog (tocino) or longsilog (longganisa).

questions.text: What Japanese dish is made of vinegared rice, often topped or rolled with raw fish?
questions.hostNotes: Not sashimi, which is raw fish without rice.

questions.text: Which country is famous for croissants and baguettes?
What fruit is the main ingredient of guacamole?
Kimchi, a spicy fermented cabbage dish, comes from which country?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: South Korea.

questions.text: What spiky, strong-smelling fruit, called the "king of fruits", is a Davao favorite?
What salty fermented shrimp or fish paste is the classic partner of green mango?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: bagoong alamang, bagoong isda, shrimp paste.

questions.text: Paella, a rice dish cooked in a wide pan, comes from which country?
What Kapampangan dish of chopped pig's face is served on a sizzling plate?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: sizzling sisig, pork sisig.

questions.text: What Bacolod grilled chicken is marinated in calamansi and vinegar and basted with annatto oil?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: inasal, inasal na manok.

questions.text: Tanduay is a famous Filipino brand of what liquor?
What spicy pork-and-chili dish cooked in coconut milk is named after a passenger train?
questions.hostNotes: Named after the PNR train line running from Manila to Bicol.

questions.text: What chewy, jelly-like cubes made from fermented coconut water are often added to halo-halo?
questions.hostNotes: Not kaong, which is sugar palm fruit. Not nata de piña, made from pineapple.

questions.text: What purple Christmas rice cake is steamed in bamboo tubes?
questions.hostNotes: Not bibingka, which is baked in banana leaves.

questions.text: Pho, a beef noodle soup, is the national dish of which country?
Which Italian city is known as the birthplace of pizza?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Napoli.

questions.text: What Ilocano vegetable dish combines squash, eggplant, ampalaya, okra and string beans?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pakbet.

questions.text: Which Western Visayas island province is famous for its sweet mangoes?
questions.hostNotes: Not Zambales, which is also known for mangoes but is in Luzon.

questions.text: What legume is the main ingredient of hummus?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: garbanzos, garbanzo beans.

questions.text: What powdered Japanese green tea is used in lattes, ice cream and cakes?
Feta, a crumbly white cheese, traditionally comes from which country?
What Mexican spirit is distilled from the blue agave plant?
questions.hostNotes: Mezcal can be made from many agaves, but blue agave points to tequila.

questions.text: What Japanese word names the savory "fifth taste", after sweet, sour, salty and bitter?
What Ilocano dish is pork belly boiled, air-dried, then deep-fried until crackling?
questions.hostNotes: Not lechon kawali, the Tagalog pan-fried version.

questions.text: What Iloilo noodle soup with pork offal and crushed chicharon is named after a district of the city?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: batchoy.

questions.text: What Ilocano soup of goat or beef innards gets its bitter taste from bile?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: papaitan.

questions.text: What spice, the most expensive in the world by weight, comes from the stigmas of a crocus flower?
Which Italian coffee drink is an espresso "stained" with a small amount of milk foam?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: caffè macchiato, espresso macchiato. Macchiato means "stained" or "marked".

questions.text: What French word is used on menus for edible snails?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: escargots.

questions.text: What Cebuano "hanging rice" is cooked in pouches of woven coconut leaves?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pusô. A similar rice pouch is called ketupat in Malaysia and Indonesia.

questions.text: What ginger-based chicken soup is served at the dinner in Chapter 3 of "Noli Me Tangere"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: tinolang manok. Padre Damaso sulks when he gets the neck and a tough wing.

questions.text: Pili nuts come mainly from which Philippine region?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Bicol Region, Region V. Sorsogon and Albay are major producers.

questions.text: Kape alamid is coffee made from beans that pass through the gut of what animal?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: palm civet, musang, alamid. Indonesia's version is kopi luwak.

questions.text: Batangas's kapeng barako comes mainly from which coffee species?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Coffea liberica. Not Arabica or Robusta.

questions.text: What Kapampangan delicacy is made from mole crickets cooked adobo-style?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: kamaru.

questions.text: Which Italian coffee-and-mascarpone dessert has a name meaning "pick me up"?
